title: The Otter's Lesson
source_reference: Islamic teachings on the importance of cleanliness (tahara)
source_detail: Hadith about cleanliness as part of faith
description: A little otter learns the joy of being clean and fresh. A playful story about self-care and the importance of staying pure.

pages.text: Once upon a time, in a lush green forest by a sparkling stream, lived a little otter named Omar.
pages.illustration_prompt: A vibrant forest scene with a playful otter, Omar, beside a sparkling stream. The forest is lush with greenery and colorful flowers.

pages.text: Omar loved to play in the mud all day. He would roll around and giggle with his friends.
pages.illustration_prompt: Omar the otter rolling in the mud with other otter friends, all looking happy. The mud is rich brown, contrasting with the otters' shiny fur.

pages.text: One day, his mother said, 'Omar, it's time to wash up. Cleanliness is part of faith.'
pages.illustration_prompt: Omar’s mother, an older otter with a gentle smile, speaking to Omar. The background is a calm part of the stream, glistening under the sun.

pages.text: Omar didn't want to stop playing, but he loved his mother. So, he waddled to the stream.
pages.illustration_prompt: Omar looking a bit reluctant but obedient, walking towards the stream. The sunlight creates sparkles on the water surface.

pages.text: The water was cool and refreshing. Omar splashed and cleaned himself, feeling lighter.
pages.illustration_prompt: Omar joyfully splashing water on himself, looking refreshed. Water droplets catch the sunlight, creating tiny rainbows.

pages.text: As he washed, he noticed how his fur shone and smelled fresh like flowers.
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of Omar’s fur glistening in the sunlight, with flowers in the background, depicting freshness and cleanliness.

pages.text: His friends joined him, and they played in the clean water, laughing happily.
pages.illustration_prompt: Omar and his otter friends playing joyfully in the clear stream, splashing water with big smiles. The scene is lively and joyful.

pages.text: After they finished, they lay on the soft grass, feeling calm and content.
pages.illustration_prompt: Omar and his friends lying on vibrant green grass, under a soft blue sky, looking peaceful and content.

pages.text: Omar realized how wonderful it felt to be clean. He smiled at his mother.
pages.illustration_prompt: Omar looking up at his mother with a big smile, surrounded by flowers and greenery, in a warm, nurturing scene.

pages.text: 'Being clean is truly part of faith,' Omar thought, feeling proud.
pages.illustration_prompt: A thoughtful Omar with his eyes closed in reflection, a soft glow around him, highlighting his sense of pride and understanding.

pages.text: From that day on, Omar washed every day, enjoying his clean fur.
pages.illustration_prompt: Omar in the stream washing himself, looking joyful and refreshed, with the stream flowing happily around him.

pages.text: He loved how his fur shimmered in the sun, feeling fresh and happy.
pages.illustration_prompt: Omar sitting by the stream, his fur shimmering in the sunlight, surrounded by colorful nature.

pages.text: Mama Otter was proud. 'You are a clean and wonderful otter, Omar,' she said.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mama Otter with a loving expression, looking at Omar. The scene is warm and full of affection, with soft colors.

pages.text: Omar felt loved and happy with his clean fur and pure heart.
pages.illustration_prompt: Omar sitting happily with his friends and family, a serene forest scene surrounding them, full of love and warmth.

pages.text: He closed his eyes, ready to dream of more playful, clean days.
pages.illustration_prompt: Omar, with his eyes gently closed, surrounded by a magical forest landscape, ready for peaceful dreams.

pages.text: Goodnight, dear Omar. Sweet dreams until the sun rises again.
pages.illustration_prompt: A night-time scene with Omar sleeping peacefully under a starlit sky, the stream softly reflecting the moonlight.
